things.name: Cheetah

must_show: The cheetah has a slim, lightly built body with a small, streamlined head and a short snout.
It has long thin legs and a long spotted tail.
Black tear-like streaks run from the corners of its eyes down the nose to the mouth.
not_this: A cheetah does not have the leopard's rosettes, and it does have tear streaks.
Its claws are not fully retractable like other big cats' claws.

Its fur is tawny to creamy white or pale buff, darker along the middle of the back.
Its body is covered with about 2,000 evenly spaced solid black spots.
Its chin, throat, belly and the lower parts of its legs are white with no markings.
Black tear-like streaks run from the corners of its eyes down the nose to the mouth.
Its ears are small, short and rounded, with black patches on the back.
It has a short, rough mane along the neck and shoulders.
Its claws are slightly curved, blunt and only partly retractable.
It stands 67–94 cm tall at the shoulder and its head-and-body length is 1.1 to 1.5 m.
Its eyes are set high and have round pupils.
